core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Academic Heritage with Modern SaaS.
Content is King: Every pixel must serve the narrative of 'Impact'.
Zoom In: Use close-ups of students to create empathy.
Negative Space: Value empty areas for breathing room.
anti_patterns: No generic 'SaaS Blue' as primary color.
No center-aligned text blocks longer than 3 lines.

usage_rules: Headings (H1-H3): Playfair Display. Bold, tight tracking (-0.02em).
Overlines/Labels: JetBrains Mono. Uppercase, wide tracking (0.1em).

accent.name: Growth Green
accent.usage: Success states, Financial data, Progress bars.

grid_system.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid (Dense, Data-focused).

buttons.primary: bg-amber-500 text-indigo-950 hover:bg-amber-400 font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-3 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-indigo-950 text-indigo-950 hover:bg-indigo-950 hover:text-white font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-all

cards.marketing: bg-white border border-amber-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all p-8

inputs.default: bg-white border-gray-200 focus:border-amber-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-200 rounded-sm

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain overlay on backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.decorations: Use abstract geometric shapes in Amber/Indigo to guide the eye.

motion.hover_effects: Lift up (-4px) on hover for cards.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders with shimmering amber gradient.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is always legible. Use Indigo-950 on Amber-500, not White.
accessibility.aria: All interactive elements must have aria-labels.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Style: Stroke width 1.5px, Indigo-950 color.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a platform that bridges the gap between underprivileged talent and corporate resources. The design must feel 'Expensive' yet 'Accessible'. Avoid the 'Charity' look (sad, poor). Go for the 'Opportunity' look (bright, ambitious).

pages.landing: Use the 'Tetris Grid' layout. Mix large student portraits with bold typography stats. Use the Marigold color for CTAs.
pages.student_dashboard: Mobile-first. Big buttons. Clear progress bars. Use 'Gamification' elements (badges, streaks).
pages.company_dashboard: Data-dense. Use tables with clear headers. Use the 'Deep Indigo' color for the sidebar.

implementation_steps: 1. Install fonts and configure Tailwind theme.
3. Build the 'UI Kit' (Buttons, Cards, Inputs) based on the design system.
4. Implement the Landing Page using the 'Tetris Grid'.

do_not: Do not use generic blue (#3B82F6) as primary.
Do not make the design look like a Bootstrap template.
do: Use the 'Marigold' (#F59E0B) color for primary actions.
Ensure all images have 'object-cover' and proper aspect ratios.
